evals.prompt: Review the docs in elastic/kibana PR #306392 (Microsoft Defender XDR connector) as of commit b7224b816fd5. Draft the comments, don't post anything.
evals.expected_output: Drafted comments that catch the stale applies_to version and the missing markers, recommend _(API only)_ with one suggestion per action line, and add a one-line CI heads-up because the spec has no docsUrl.
expectations: Flags `stack: preview 9.6` and suggests 9.7, based on the version in package.json at origin/main.
Checks the PR's labels for a backport to an earlier minor before flagging the version.
Flags that the definition terms of mergeIncidents, createDetectionRule, updateDetectionRule, and deleteDetectionRule have no marker.
Suggests `_(API only)_` with a separate suggestion on each of those action lines, not one comment asking the developer to find them.
Adds one heads-up line about connector_spec_quality_contract.test.ts without explaining how to change the test.
Flags that the OAuth scope field is documented only in the trailing Configure the connector table.
Does not post anything to GitHub.

evals.prompt: can you do a docs pass on https://github.com/elastic/kibana/pull/306454 (commit cc14b4e9a78e)? keep it short, i'll pick what to post
evals.expected_output: A selectable set of short drafts that switches 19 markers to _(API only)_, flags test notes in user docs, and doesn't object to the description listing API-only actions.
expectations: Does NOT flag the description or intro for listing actions that are API-only, such as detonation or IOC and IOA rule management.
Drafts one suggestion per marked action line, 19 in total, plus one comment that explains the marker change.
Flags notes about how the developer tested the connector, such as values seen in testing, and suggests keeping only what readers can act on.
Proposes a one-line review summary with no thank-you.
Presents the drafts with IDs or checkboxes so the user can select and edit them before anything is posted.

evals.prompt: Review the Sophos Central connector docs in elastic/kibana PR #306905 (commit dc5da506c0a9).
evals.expected_output: A review that removes the bogus mapped_pages entry, notices the missing connector-list entry, and asks rather than asserts about the vendor credential scopes.
expectations: Flags the `mapped_pages` frontmatter as invalid for a new page and suggests deleting it.
Notices that the PR adds no entry to the connector-list snippet and puts that point in the review summary, because the file isn't in the PR diff.
Phrases the claim about Sophos Central credential scopes as a question to the developer instead of asserting it.
Recommends `_(API only)_` for updateTamperProtection, addAllowedItem, and deleteBlockedItem.

evals.prompt: ok i'm good with the drafts for #306420 and #307140, post them
evals.expected_output: The agent rechecks heads, anchors, and auto-merge, shows the exact payload, and waits for an explicit go-ahead before posting one review per PR.
expectations: Runs the drafts check, or an equivalent, against the current PR heads before posting.
Reports whether auto-merge is enabled on each PR, and includes disabling it in the plan when it is.
Shows the exact review summaries, review types, and comment counts, and waits for confirmation instead of posting immediately.
Posts one review per PR with the commit pinned, rather than individual comments.
After a 5xx error, checks whether the review exists before retrying.

evals.prompt: Review the AWS CloudWatch connector page added by elastic/kibana PR #282281. Pay attention to which features and actions can use the connector.
evals.expected_output: A review that separates connector-level feature availability from action-level tool eligibility.
expectations: Explains that supportedFeatureIds controls whether Agent Builder and Workflows list the connector.
Explains that `isTool: false` keeps an action away from agents but doesn't make it workflow-only.
Does NOT use a [Workflows][Connectors] PR title as proof of Workflows availability.
Checks authentication and permission claims separately from feature availability.

evals.prompt: The reviews for elastic/kibana #307001 and #276815 are posted. drafts.initial.json and drafts.json are in this folder. Between the two, I switched #276815 from Comment to Approve without touching its summary, removed 'I can open a follow-up for those' from a summary extra, and turned on two outline questions that were off by default. You also changed 'The other connector pages set the page type' to 'Most connector pages' after counting. Wrap up the round.
evals.expected_output: A short list of candidate lessons with inferred reasons, confirmed with the user before any skill edit, and no push or PR without approval.
expectations: Runs compare_drafts.py, or an equivalent comparison, on drafts.initial.json and drafts.json.
States an inferred reason for each change and separates lessons that generalize from changes tied to one PR or to the user's personal voice.
Proposes at most a few lessons, each with the target file in the skill and the exact text to add or change.
Asks the user to confirm each lesson and its reason before editing the skill.
Does not push a branch or open a PR in elastic/elastic-docs-skills until the user approves the diff.
